desc: Implement the bounded two-layer DP with skip/take transitions and safe alternating-sum indexing.
Handle zeros, singleton subsequences, duplicate values, and empty-subsequence exclusion.
Correctly exclude singleton products greater than `limit`.
Validate all three examples and compare against exhaustive brute force, including values greater than `limit`.
Benchmark dense worst-case inputs near `n = 150` and `limit = 5000` after correctness was restored.
